passages.locator: In 1842 Raja Gangadhar Rao married Mannikarnika
passages.excerpt_preview: During his period the local population of Jhansi was very satisfied. In 1842 Raja Gangadhar Rao married Mannikarnika. After this marriage Mannikarnika was given the new name Lakshmi Bai, who led forces against British in 1857.

passages.locator: The British rulers then accepted Gangadhar Rao
passages.excerpt_preview: In 1838 Raghunath Rao (III) also died. The British rulers then accepted Gangadhar Rao as the Raja of Jhansi. Due to the inefficient administration during the period of Raghunath Rao (III) the financial position of Jhansi was very critical.
